sentences.en: A man stood behind the gate gazing at the house.
sentences.zh: 一个男人站在门后凝视着那座房子。

sentences.en: He stood gazing at the sight with his mouth open.
sentences.zh: 他张口结舌地注视着眼前的景象。

sentences.en: The little boy gazed at the huge elephant, eyes wide open.
sentences.zh: 小男孩睁大眼睛盯着那只巨大的大象。

senses.zh: 凝视，注视；特定视角，特定角度
